_about: Hand-authored finding authority. Every sourceLocations[].symbol is grep-verified by the generator; every proofIds[] entry must exist in evidence/ with matching source fingerprints. Counts are never written here; the generator derives them.

findings.title: Workspace 'Queue telemetry sampler delayed' is derived from Home page loads, not from the worker sampler

plans: ALL (sweep runs for every workspace regardless of plan)

findings.scope: WORKSPACE row describing a fact that is not about the workspace
findings.reproduction: Insert fresh worker BULLMQ snapshots (team_id NULL) and one 17h-old DB_DERIVED workspace snapshot; run reconcileWorkspaceOperations; condition opens HIGH at 1020 minutes. A Home GET resolves it; 31 minutes later it reopens even after another Home GET (lazy refill only when no row in 240 minutes). A workspace that never loaded Home never gets the condition even with zero worker samples.
findings.expected: A sampler-delay condition measures the real BullMQ sampler and belongs to the platform control plane.
findings.actual: The probe reads QueueTelemetrySnapshot WHERE teamId = workspace; only Home's lazy DB-derived writer produces such rows; the worker writes team_id NULL and its queue_health log line is never persisted. The condition says 'The worker remains operational; the sampler may be delayed' while measuring Home visits.
findings.userImpact: Every workspace that ever opened Home shows a permanent false HIGH 'sampler delayed' condition that also feeds OPS-002.

operationsDuplicates.detail: Second, invented queue-health detector per workspace beside the platform queue inventory and worker liveness authorities.

findings.remediationBoundary: Remove platform.telemetry_stale from tenant discovery (or make it PLATFORM_INTERNAL and measure team_id NULL BULLMQ rows); never write telemetry from a GET; close existing rows with an explicit reconciliation.
findings.regressionProof: With fresh worker samples and an old workspace DB_DERIVED row, no tenant-visible condition exists; with no worker samples for > window, a single platform condition exists and closes when a sample lands.
findings.dataReconciliation: Yes: resolve all open platform.telemetry_stale WORKSPACE rows with an audited reconciliation note.
findings.productionOwnerAction: Deploy + one-off reconciliation of existing rows.

findings.title: 'Queue retry storm' counts this workspace's re-observed conditions, not queue retries; its drill-down lists only itself; Home counts it twice
findings.reproduction: Leave any two conditions open for 5 sweeps: the storm opens (WARNING, HIGH at 3) naming no queue; the drill-down returns the storm row only; Home's retryStormIncidents read 3 while only 2 other conditions qualified.
findings.expected: A retry storm is measured from BullMQ retries/failures and names the queues/jobs; otherwise it does not exist.
findings.actual: occurrenceCount is incremented by every sweep re-observation, so any persistent condition (telemetry, storage, search) becomes a 'queue retry storm'.
findings.userImpact: Reem's 'Queue retry storm — 2 repeatedly observed conditions' was this artefact; tenants are told queues are retrying when none are.

operationsDuplicates.detail: Invents a queue signal from incident bookkeeping.

findings.remediationBoundary: Retire queue.retry_storm as a tenant source; if kept for platform, compute from BullMQ attempts/failed counts. Separate 'observation count' from 'occurrence count'.
findings.regressionProof: Persistent unrelated conditions never open a retry storm; a BullMQ job failing N times does (platform scope).

findings.title: Personal storage add-on obligation: never auto-resolves, can be manually 'resolved' while live, drawer blames platform infrastructure
findings.scope: BILLING_ACCOUNT (personal) surfaced in the Personal Space
findings.reproduction: Personal add-on (team_id NULL) in PENDING/RETRY_SCHEDULED/ACTION_REQUIRED/MANUAL_INTERVENTION: POST /v1/ops/incidents/:id/resolve returns 200 in every state. Set CONFIRMED, or let the retry sweep withdraw the obligation to NONE: three sweeps later the condition is still OPEN with occurrenceCount frozen (first = last seen). TEAM and Enterprise payers correctly refuse manual close (409) but also never auto-close after CONFIRMED.
findings.expected: The condition closes when the provider confirms or the obligation is withdrawn; manual close is refused while the obligation is live; the drawer links to Billing.
findings.actual: No sweep calls the source-truth recovery for this source; the probe matches teamId strictly so personal add-ons read NOT_APPLICABLE, which ALLOW_OPERATOR_CLOSE turns into a permitted manual resolve. The drawer says 'cannot be marked resolved by hand' and 'platform infrastructure'.
findings.userImpact: Reem's 'still billing after cancellation' row was stuck open; a user can hide a live billing obligation with one click.
findings.securityPrivacyImpact: Financial truth: a live charge can be concealed from the operator surface.

operationsDuplicates.detail: Re-implements 'resolved' as CONFIRMED||NONE instead of the billing UNRESOLVED_STATES authority.

findings.remediationBoundary: Resolve by owner (personal) or team; wire sweepSourceTruthRecoveries for the source; refuse manual close while UNRESOLVED; deep-link to /billing retry.
findings.regressionProof: CONFIRMED and NONE close the condition (personal and team); manual resolve while live returns 409 for personal add-ons; drawer offers the Billing link.
findings.dataReconciliation: Yes: re-evaluate every open billing.dependent_cancellation_failed row against its add-on.
findings.productionOwnerAction: Read the specific Production add-on behind Reem's row (owner), deploy, reconcile.

findings.title: Report failure condition auto-resolves while a newer version is failed or still processing
findings.reproduction: Evidence with report v1; a newer REPORT request FAILED_TERMINAL or PROCESSING (stage NULL, as every non-committed attempt has); sweep -> condition RESOLVED 'no longer reported by its source'.
findings.expected: The condition stays open until the failed version exists.
findings.actual: A Prisma `not` filter excludes NULL stage rows, so every failed/live newer attempt is invisible and v1 reads as recovery.
findings.userImpact: A failed updated report silently disappears from Operations.

operationsDuplicates.detail: Own in-flight predicate instead of the canonical one.

findings.remediationBoundary: Use the canonical in-flight/terminal predicate with explicit NULL-stage handling and version from the fingerprint.
findings.regressionProof: v2 FAILED_TERMINAL or PROCESSING with v1 present keeps the condition OPEN; v2 committed resolves it.
findings.dataReconciliation: Yes: re-open conditions resolved by this predicate whose newer request is not committed.

findings.title: /v1/ops/* enforces role only; plan/entitlement is enforced in the web alone
findings.reproduction: FREE personal owner (envelope OPERATIONS_VIEW=false): GET incidents/summary/detail/health 200; POST ack/suppress 200; workspace-reconcile 202. Same for expired/revoked grant and CANCELED/INACTIVE owned TEAM.
findings.expected: The API refuses Operations for a workspace whose plan does not include it, with a typed reason consistent with the web.
findings.actual: No plan check anywhere in ops.routes.ts; web shows 'Missing required capability: OPERATIONS_VIEW'.
findings.userImpact: Inconsistent entitlement; downgraded workspaces keep full Operations via API/native clients.
findings.securityPrivacyImpact: Entitlement bypass on own data (no cross-tenant read).
findings.remediationBoundary: Derive the API gate from the same capability resolution the envelope uses (OPERATIONS_VIEW etc.), not a second plan table.
findings.regressionProof: Matrix cells PERSONAL_FREE_OWNER / PERSONAL_EXPIRED_GRANT / OWNED_TEAM_CANCELED_OWNER return 403 with the same reason the web shows.
findings.productionOwnerAction: Product decision on what FREE sees (see recommendation).

findings.title: Worker scheduled sweeps send x-cron-secret; the API authenticates x-proovra-integration-cron-secret (deterministic 401)
findings.reproduction: With INTEGRATION_CRON_SECRET set, POST /v1/org-invite-deliveries/process and /v1/automation/runs/process: worker header -> 401, canonical header -> 200.
findings.expected: Worker and API use one header contract.
findings.actual: Every worker sweep is refused; the failure is logged only and never reaches any Operations surface.
findings.userImpact: Org-invite retry outbox and automation dispatch/webhook outbox never run (matches the Production 401 warnings).
findings.remediationBoundary: One shared header constant used by worker and API; surface sustained sweep refusals on the platform control plane.
findings.regressionProof: Integration test: worker client against API route returns 200.
findings.dataReconciliation: Re-drive stranded invite deliveries/automation runs after deploy.

findings.title: Detail and list reads share one request counter: after any action with the drawer open the list never refreshes and Refresh stays disabled
findings.reproduction: Open a condition drawer in 'All conditions', press Acknowledge: server row is ACKNOWLEDGED, drawer still shows 'Open', Refresh shows 'Refreshing…' disabled, also after closing the drawer.
findings.expected: A successful action refreshes list, summary and drawer.
findings.actual: Refresh deadlock confirmed in the browser. The previously claimed 'old workspace rows after switching' was NOT reproduced: the modal drawer blocks the workspace switcher, and a switch with the drawer closed rendered only the new workspace. Severity lowered to P2 (stale presentation; server state correct).
findings.userImpact: Operators see stale status and a stuck Refresh until reload.
findings.remediationBoundary: Separate sequence counters per read (or AbortController per request); clear refreshing in all branches.
findings.regressionProof: Browser: ack with drawer open updates the badge and re-enables Refresh.

findings.title: Scheduled Operations sweep only ranks the 500 oldest workspaces
findings.reproduction: 509+ teams, all but the newest with a fresh run: runWorkspaceOperationsSweep reconciles 0 and the never-run newest workspace is never selected.
findings.expected: Every workspace is eventually swept.
findings.actual: The candidate list is truncated before ranking; newer workspaces depend on a manual 'Check again'.
findings.userImpact: Home, Notifications and Operations for newer tenants go stale; conditions are neither opened nor auto-resolved.
findings.remediationBoundary: Rank in SQL (never-run first, oldest run next) without a creation-order truncation; report coverage on the platform plane.
findings.regressionProof: With N > 500 teams, a never-run workspace is selected on the next tick.
findings.productionOwnerAction: Deploy; check Production team count to size impact (blocked: no Production access).

findings.title: Per-workspace worker-heartbeat conditions never auto-resolve and open SLA cycles
findings.reproduction: Stale heartbeat -> CRITICAL WORKSPACE row (hidden); fresh heartbeat + 2 sweeps -> still OPEN; one SLA cycle opened on the hidden row.
findings.expected: One platform condition that closes when a heartbeat lands.
findings.actual: The resolver looks the row up through the tenant predicate that excludes PLATFORM_INTERNAL sources; it never finds it.
findings.userImpact: Platform console accumulates one permanent CRITICAL per workspace per outage.

operationsDuplicates.detail: Second heartbeat detector (15 min) beside worker liveness (180 s).

findings.remediationBoundary: Write heartbeat staleness once at PLATFORM scope from the liveness authority; resolve with a platform predicate.
findings.regressionProof: Fresh heartbeat closes the single platform row; no per-workspace copies.
findings.dataReconciliation: Yes: close existing per-workspace heartbeat rows.

findings.title: GET /v1/ops/health gives any workspace member (VIEWER, FREE) process-global configuration and unscoped counts
findings.reproduction: VIEWER GET /v1/ops/health: snapshot/violations/observability/alerts with env-var names (TWILIO_ACCOUNT_SID, TWILIO_API_KEY, TWILIO_API_SECRET); incidents.openCritical=1 counts a hidden platform heartbeat row while the tenant list shows 0.
findings.expected: Platform configuration only on the platform control plane; tenant counts use the tenant predicate.
findings.actual: Gate is operations.view; counts filter teamId only.
findings.userImpact: Workspace members see infrastructure posture and counts that disagree with their queue.

operationsDuplicates.detail: Duplicates platform readiness in a customer route.

findings.remediationBoundary: Move to requirePlatformAdmin (as /v1/ops/metrics and /v1/ops/alerts were) or reduce to tenant-scoped counts via workspaceIncidentWhere.
findings.regressionProof: VIEWER gets 403 or a tenant-only payload without env names.

findings.title: Web bulk outcome counts SUCCEEDED; the API returns COMPLETED — every successful bulk run is shown as failed
findings.reproduction: Server: runBulkAction -> items COMPLETED. Browser: a fully successful bulk acknowledge renders '0 of 2 updated. 2 could not be changed and remain selected.' The web also sends no idempotencyKey.
findings.expected: The web reads the server's vocabulary.
findings.actual: Mismatch; native reads COMPLETED correctly.
findings.userImpact: Operators retry successful bulk actions.
findings.remediationBoundary: Share the item-status type from the API contract; send idempotencyKey.
findings.regressionProof: Browser: successful bulk shows 'N updated'.

findings.title: Default Grouped view: group drawer has only 'Close'; no actions and no route to the condition drawer
findings.reproduction: Open /operations (Grouped default), open the storage or retry-storm group: controls = ['Close'].
findings.expected: Every group exposes its members' canonical actions or a link to each condition.
findings.actual: Only counts; this is why Reem saw no recovery action for the report failure.
findings.userImpact: Actionable conditions look non-actionable in the default view.
findings.remediationBoundary: Group members open the condition drawer; group header shows the source's canonical action when uniform.
findings.regressionProof: Browser: group drawer -> condition drawer -> canonical action.

findings.title: 'Retry after exhausted failure' (supersede) is never offered; the offered action tells the user to use it
findings.reproduction: TEAM workspace, exhausted TECHNICAL failure: detail offers only report.regenerate_artifacts; executing it returns 409 'Use "Retry after exhausted failure"'; POST of report.supersede_failed_generation directly returns 202 QUEUED through requestOutputRecovery; a double submit is refused (no second request).
findings.expected: The supersede action is offered to an operator holding operations.resolve.
findings.actual: The detail route's permission cache never loads operations.resolve, so the action is filtered out.
findings.userImpact: Dead end for exhausted report failures.
findings.remediationBoundary: Load operations.resolve into the cache (or ask the canonical authority).
findings.regressionProof: Detail for an exhausted technical failure lists the supersede action for owner/admin only.

findings.title: Expected 403 refusals become a customer-visible 'Identity security condition'

personas: any refused member; visible to all operators

findings.reproduction: A VIEWER requests /v1/ops/assignable-operators and a MEMBER suppresses (both 403): owner's queue shows 'Identity security condition' (stored title 'Security signal: permission_denied'), occurrences 2.
findings.expected: Routine authorization refusals stay in the security log.
findings.actual: permission_denied is mapped to a tenant-visible condition that also feeds the retry storm.
findings.userImpact: Noise; reveals who attempted what to all operators.
findings.securityPrivacyImpact: Security telemetry exposed as customer incident.

operationsDuplicates.detail: Security events re-surfaced as operations conditions.

findings.remediationBoundary: Classify permission_denied as routine (no incident).
findings.regressionProof: 403s produce no OperationalIncident.
findings.dataReconciliation: Yes: close identity.security_condition rows fingerprinted on permission_denied.

findings.title: Failures for personal records stored with team_id NULL become LEGACY_UNSCOPED and are invisible to their owner
findings.reproduction: recordWorkerIncident(teamId NULL) for a personal record: scope LEGACY_UNSCOPED; not in the owner's Personal Space list; summary open = 0.
findings.expected: The condition is attributed to the record's canonical workspace (workspaceEvidenceWhere).
findings.actual: Invisible on every tenant surface.
findings.userImpact: Report/package failures on legacy personal records are never shown.
findings.remediationBoundary: Writers resolve the record's workspace before recording.
findings.regressionProof: Personal NULL-team record failure appears in the owner's Personal Space.
findings.dataReconciliation: Yes: re-scope LEGACY_UNSCOPED pipeline rows whose record resolves to a workspace.

findings.title: Raw error text becomes the customer summary (verbatim to VIEWERs) and part of the fingerprint
findings.reproduction: A worker-written condition whose summary contains an S3 bucket and KMS ARN is projected verbatim to a VIEWER (runtime); the processor derives that summary and the fingerprint from Error.message (source).
findings.expected: Customer text is a bounded, classified code; identity is per record.
findings.actual: No sanitisation (coerceSafeSummary only trims).
findings.userImpact: Internal infrastructure names reach customers; one record can open several conditions.
findings.remediationBoundary: Classify errors to closed codes before recording; fingerprint per (record, class).
findings.regressionProof: Error messages with bucket/ARN never appear in projected summaries.
findings.dataReconciliation: Yes: rewrite stored summaries of open pipeline rows.

findings.title: 'Search index reconciliation failing' opens when no reconciliation has ever run (and when work is already scheduled)
findings.reproduction: Workspace with records and zero SEARCH_INDEX runs -> STALLED -> FAILING -> condition opens. Canonical classifier: 'never run, work scheduled' is also STALLED; RUNNING with live lease is PARTIAL/indeterminate (correct); empty workspace and READY close the condition (correct, DB-proven).
findings.expected: 'Not yet measured' distinct from 'failing'.
findings.actual: Title claims failure.
findings.userImpact: False failure claim on new workspaces.
findings.remediationBoundary: Wording/state: open as 'not yet indexed' (advisory) for never-run; keep FAILED/STALLED-with-history as failing.
findings.regressionProof: Never-run workspace shows a not-yet-measured state, not 'failing'.

findings.title: Sources declared PROBE_AUTO_RESOLVE that nothing closes (one is permanently stuck)
findings.reproduction: With the source healthy, two sweeps leave OPEN: evidence_integrity.ots_budget_exhausted, pipeline.package_generation_denied, review.escalation, identity.idp_outage (plus billing.dependent_cancellation_failed OPS-003 and platform.worker_heartbeat_stale OPS-009). Three then accept a manual close; package_generation_denied refuses even that (409 CONDITION_STILL_ACTIVE) and can never close.
findings.expected: Every auto-resolve claim has a wired resolver.
findings.actual: Claims without resolvers.
findings.userImpact: Permanently open conditions; manual closes without source proof.
findings.remediationBoundary: Either wire sweepSourceTruthRecoveries per source or change the declared recovery policy; conservation test over the registry.
findings.regressionProof: Registry gate: every PROBE_AUTO_RESOLVE source has an executed resolver test.

findings.title: TSA and OTS failure conditions resolve on any non-FAILED status (NULL, PENDING, unvalidated STAMPED)
findings.reproduction: FAILED -> NULL / PENDING / STAMPED-without-validation all RESOLVED 'tsaStatus is no longer FAILED'; OTS FAILED -> PENDING / NULL also RESOLVED although the registry states 'otsStatus reaches ANCHORED or UPGRADED'. Original failure stays in history (correct).
findings.expected: TSA closes on a validated stamp; OTS on ANCHORED/UPGRADED.
findings.actual: 'not FAILED'. Severity raised from P3: OTS registry contract is contradicted at runtime.
findings.userImpact: A trust failure can disappear without proof of recovery.

operationsDuplicates.detail: Own predicate instead of the trust authority's verified state.

findings.remediationBoundary: Resolve on the canonical verified/anchored predicate.
findings.regressionProof: PENDING/NULL never resolve; validated stamp / ANCHORED do.
findings.dataReconciliation: Review resolved integrity rows whose record is not verified.

findings.title: Drawer/page UX and accessibility: no focus move/trap, wrong focus restore, English-only in de/ar, no deep link, Load-more in grouped view
findings.reproduction: Browser: opening a drawer leaves focus outside it; one Tab leaves the drawer; Escape restores focus to a row checkbox; no live region announces action results; German and Arabic render the page in English (Arabic sets dir=rtl correctly); the drawer is not URL-addressable; grouped view shows a 'Load 50 more' that appends hidden rows. Correct: no overflow 320–1440px or at 200% root text, no sub-24px targets, no nested interactive controls, headings H1/H2, reduced motion respected, failed reads never render all-clear, 1 detail read per open, no idle polling.
findings.expected: WCAG dialog pattern; localized copy; addressable conditions.
findings.actual: As reproduced.
findings.userImpact: Keyboard/screen-reader and non-English users disadvantaged.
findings.remediationBoundary: Use the shared dialog primitive with trap/restore; route i18n through the shared dictionary; add ?incident= deep link; gate Load more on flat view.
findings.regressionProof: Browser a11y suite (focus trap, restore, live region), de/ar snapshots.

findings.title: Web capability envelope disagrees with API authority (revoked rows counted, expired access, suspended org)

personas: sole owner with revoked ex-members; expired-access member; suspended-org owner

findings.reproduction: FREE owned workspace with one ACTIVE owner and one REVOKED row: envelope grants OPERATIONS_VIEW/ACK/RESOLVE/SUPPRESS/ASSIGN. Member with expired access and owner of a suspended org: envelope OPERATIONS_VIEW=true, API 403. Assignment to revoked/viewer is correctly refused (400).
findings.expected: One authority; envelope mirrors evaluateMemberAccess.
findings.actual: Two predicates.
findings.userImpact: Visible controls that the API refuses.
findings.remediationBoundary: Count ACTIVE, unexpired members; apply org lifecycle in the envelope.
findings.regressionProof: Matrix cells agree (apiAgreesWithWeb=true) for those three cells.

findings.title: Real BullMQ failures and retries never reach any Operations surface; persisted retryCount is hard-coded 0
findings.reproduction: A job failing 3 attempts on search-indexing: 0 OperationalIncident rows anywhere; the real worker sampler persisted failedCount 1, retryCount 0. Platform queue console shows queue health (outage during a Redis pause); customer summary unaffected (correct separation).
findings.expected: Repeated job failure is a platform condition with stable identity.
findings.actual: job.background_failure has no producer.
findings.userImpact: Platform operators learn of failures only from logs.
findings.remediationBoundary: Platform-scope producer from worker failed events (final attempt), keyed (queue, jobName, errorClass).
findings.regressionProof: Failing job N times -> one PLATFORM condition; success closes it.

findings.title: Storage add-on condition wording/category: PENDING titled 'still billing', MANUAL title replaced, category STORAGE
findings.reproduction: PENDING obligation seconds after request is titled 'still billing after cancellation'; MANUAL_INTERVENTION stored title 'support needed' is projected as the generic label; provider-unavailable retry is not distinguished; category STORAGE routes to platform-storage guidance.
findings.expected: Wording reflects state (pending / retrying / provider unavailable / needs support).
findings.actual: One label for all.
findings.userImpact: Misstates billing status.
findings.remediationBoundary: State-specific wording from the billing authority; a BILLING category or source-keyed remediation.
findings.regressionProof: Each state renders its own title and the Billing deep link.

findings.title: Queue replay eligibility admits completed jobs; BullMQ then refuses and the API reports 404 'job_not_found'
findings.reproduction: Replay of a completed job: 404 'Replay failed.' and the job stays completed. Two concurrent replays of a failed job: one 200, one 400 job_not_failed (BullMQ state prevents the duplicate). Customer owner: 403.
findings.expected: Completed work is refused with a precise reason; idempotency is explicit.
findings.actual: Duplicate side effects were NOT observed (refuted half); the misleading completed-job eligibility and 404 mapping are confirmed.
findings.userImpact: Misleading operator feedback.
findings.remediationBoundary: Refuse completed jobs in the eligibility check; map retry errors precisely; record previousState from BullMQ.
findings.regressionProof: Replay of completed -> 409 job_completed; audit carries the true previous state.

findings.title: /v1/investigation/diagnostics returns another tenant's queue job failure text to any workspace member

personas: VIEWER and up of any workspace

findings.reproduction: A tenant-B report job fails with a message naming B's evidence/team; a VIEWER of tenant A GETs /v1/investigation/diagnostics?teamId=A: queues.report.lastError contains tenant B's message and identifiers.
findings.expected: Workspace diagnostics contain only the workspace's own data; global queue state only on the platform plane.
findings.actual: Newest failed job of each global queue is returned verbatim.
findings.userImpact: Cross-tenant data leakage.
findings.securityPrivacyImpact: Cross-tenant disclosure of identifiers and error text (P1).

operationsDuplicates.detail: Customer route duplicates platform queue inspection.

findings.remediationBoundary: Remove global queue fields from tenant diagnostics (or move the route behind requirePlatformAdmin).
findings.regressionProof: Tenant-A VIEWER never receives another tenant's failure text or ids.
findings.productionOwnerAction: Deploy promptly; assess Production exposure (blocked: no Production access).

findings.title: /v1/runtime/secrets-health gives any member (VIEWER) the secrets posture: secret names, presence, AWS secret/region, fallback mode
findings.reproduction: VIEWER GET /v1/runtime/secrets-health -> 200 with health.secretName/region/fallbackMode and migrated[] of secret names with presence flags.
findings.expected: Platform admin only.
findings.actual: Gate identity.member.read.
findings.userImpact: Infrastructure posture disclosure.

operationsDuplicates.detail: No admin page exists for it.

findings.remediationBoundary: requirePlatformAdmin; add to the platform control plane.
findings.regressionProof: VIEWER 403; platform admin 200.

findings.title: No writer produces PLATFORM scope; provider-credential conditions are stored LEGACY_UNSCOPED with an hourly fingerprint and no resolver
findings.reproduction: recordIncident(teamId null, billing.provider_authorization) twice in different hours -> two LEGACY_UNSCOPED rows; platformIncidentWhere (scope=PLATFORM) excludes them; nothing resolves them.
findings.expected: Provider-wide conditions are PLATFORM scope, deduplicated, and close on recovery.
findings.actual: Unscoped accumulation.
findings.userImpact: Platform operators miss or drown in provider credential conditions.
findings.remediationBoundary: Use scopeForDeclaration({kind:'PLATFORM'}) for provider/platform writers; stable fingerprint; recovery on next successful provider call.
findings.regressionProof: Provider auth failure -> one PLATFORM row; success closes it.
findings.dataReconciliation: Yes: classify existing LEGACY_UNSCOPED provider rows.

findings.title: Report-failure recovery is proven by a DB row without verifying the stored object
findings.reproduction: Report row with a non-existent bucket/key created after the failure -> condition RESOLVED.
findings.expected: Recovery requires the canonical artifact authority's verified state.
findings.actual: Row presence only.
findings.userImpact: A missing artifact can close its failure condition.
findings.remediationBoundary: Use the canonical 'artifact published & verified' predicate.
findings.regressionProof: Row without object keeps the condition open.

findings.title: Resolve is a dead control for sources that require a resolution note: the web sends no note and has no field
findings.reproduction: POST resolve without a note on a governance.policy_condition -> 409 RESOLUTION_NOTE_REQUIRED (runtime); the web posts only {teamId} (source).
findings.expected: A visible Resolve collects the required note.
findings.actual: Every such Resolve fails with a generic banner.
findings.userImpact: Operators cannot close operator-decision conditions from the web.
findings.remediationBoundary: Note field driven by lifecycle.requiresResolutionNote.
findings.regressionProof: Browser: resolve with note succeeds; without note the button is disabled.

findings.title: 'Stop notifying' (suppress) hides a live source-truth condition with no confirmation and no recorded reason
findings.reproduction: POST suppress with a reason -> 200, row SUPPRESSED, resolutionNote null (reason dropped); audit row observability.incident.suppressed exists; web/native have no confirm; refusal copy tells users to 'suppress it with a recorded reason'.
findings.expected: Suppression is explicit risk acceptance: confirmation, reason, authority, audit.
findings.actual: Reason silently discarded.
findings.userImpact: A live billing/output/trust defect can be hidden without a record of why.
findings.remediationBoundary: Require and persist a reason; confirmation in web/native.
findings.regressionProof: Suppress without reason 400; with reason persisted and shown in history.

findings.title: Remediation guidance and deep links are keyed by category, not source: wrong guidance and generic targets
findings.reproduction: Billing condition (category STORAGE) shows 'platform infrastructure' guidance with no Billing link (runtime); 'Open evidence record' links to the /evidence library rather than the record (source).
findings.expected: Source-specific canonical owner page links.
findings.actual: Category-generic guidance.
findings.userImpact: Wrong next action.
findings.remediationBoundary: Key remediation by sourceId from OPERATIONS_SOURCE_LIFECYCLES; record-specific hrefs.
findings.regressionProof: Each source renders its owner-page link.

findings.title: POST /v1/ops/workspace-reconcile reports started:false for the request that ran the reconciliation
findings.reproduction: Five concurrent POSTs on a never-run workspace: exactly one run created (lock correct); the request that executed it inline answered started:false readiness READY, the others started:true alreadyRunning:true.
findings.expected: The response states what happened.
findings.actual: Inverted signal; no actor recorded on the run.
findings.userImpact: Clients poll unnecessarily or misreport.
findings.remediationBoundary: Return ran/alreadyRunning truthfully; pass triggeredByUserId.
findings.regressionProof: The executing request reports ran:true.

findings.title: Projected titles replace stored titles with the source label: 120 distinct conditions all read 'Governance policy condition'
findings.reproduction: Org workspace with 120 governance conditions titled 'ORG condition NNN' renders every row as 'Governance policy condition'; storage MANUAL_INTERVENTION 'support needed' renders as the generic label.
findings.expected: Per-condition specific title (bounded, safe) with the source label as secondary.
findings.actual: Indistinguishable rows.
findings.userImpact: Operators cannot tell conditions apart.
findings.remediationBoundary: Project a safe per-condition title.
findings.regressionProof: Distinct stored titles render distinctly.

findings.title: Enterprise has no organization roll-up; Operations is strictly per workspace
findings.reproduction: One organization, three workspaces: isolation correct (each sees only its own; cross-workspace ack 404; org admin without membership 404; assignment excludes revoked/viewer). No organization-level incident route exists.
findings.expected: If Enterprise promises roll-up, it reuses the same incident authority over authorized workspaces.
findings.actual: Absent (no second engine — correct — but no roll-up).
findings.userImpact: Org owners must open each workspace.
findings.remediationBoundary: Product decision; if built, union of buildOperationsSummary over authorized workspaces.
findings.regressionProof: Roll-up count equals the union of per-workspace authorized counts.

findings.title: Native Operations: no reset on workspace switch, no refresh on foreground, English-only
findings.reproduction: Source: filters, selection, open sheets not reset when activeTeamId changes; no AppState listener; ops strings hard-coded English. 156/156 mobile Operations tests pass but none covers these behaviours.
findings.expected: Switch resets state; foreground refresh; localized.
findings.actual: As described (source-proven; device runtime blocked).
findings.userImpact: Stale or mis-targeted state on mobile.
findings.securityPrivacyImpact: A bulk action could carry previous-workspace ids (rejected server-side by tenancy).
findings.remediationBoundary: Key screen state by teamId; AppState refresh; i18n.
findings.regressionProof: Native unit tests for switch reset and foreground refresh.

findings.title: A failed grouped read renders '0 groups · 0 conditions … match these filters' in the default view

sourceLocations.symbol: // A failed grouped read leaves the groups EMPTY rather than stale.

findings.reproduction: Browser: fulfil GET /v1/ops/incident-groups with 500 on a workspace with 5 unresolved conditions: summary cards show 5, the default Grouped list shows '0 groups · 0 conditions' and the no-match state. A genuinely empty reconciled workspace correctly shows 'Workspace operations are clear' (B14); a failed flat read correctly shows 'temporarily unavailable' (B06).
findings.expected: A failed read is shown as unavailable, never as an empty result.
findings.actual: The catch branch sets groups to [] and the page renders the empty/no-match state; native shows 'Grouped conditions could not be loaded' (source).
findings.userImpact: Operators read 'nothing here' while conditions exist.
findings.remediationBoundary: Track a grouped-read error state and render UnavailableState, as the flat read and the native screen already do.
findings.regressionProof: Browser: grouped 500 renders the unavailable state with Retry.
